title: Denials and Refutations: Tagadja, hogy... & Cáfolja, hogy...

sections.title: Reporting Negative Claims
sections.content: You know *cáfol* from B1 Unit 25. To report denials or rejections, Hungarian uses *tagadja, hogy...* (denies that...) and *cáfolja, hogy...* (refutes that...). Notice that the *hogy* clause is not negated: the denial is in the main verb. The clause often has *volna* or the conditional (*lenne*), which marks a claim the speaker rejects.

items.spanish: A vállalat képviselője határozottan tagadta, hogy hibát követtek volna el.
items.english: The company representative strictly denied that they had made a mistake.

items.spanish: A politikus cáfolta azokat a sajtóértesüléseket, amelyek a lemondásáról szóltak.
items.english: The politician refuted those press reports that spoke of his resignation.

items.spanish: Nem állította azt, hogy a feladat egyszerű lenne.
items.english: He did not claim that the task would be simple.
